stories.h: Elon Musk warns the rise of AI could be like summoning a demon
stories.s: Musk’s stark framing keeps AI safety and governance in the public eye as machine intelligence grows, influencing how readers think about risks and oversight.
b: Quote attributed to Elon Musk: 'With artificial intelligence, we are summoning the demon.'
Coverage published by TechRadar and Yahoo Tech highlighting the quote as the day’s quote of the day on the rise of machine intelligence
The articles frame the remark as a warning about AI’s rapid development without detailing any follow-up actions or policy proposals
body: Elon Musk described the rise of artificial intelligence with the line 'With artificial intelligence, we are summoning the demon,' a remark highlighted by TechRadar and Yahoo Tech as the quote of the day.
TechRadar and Yahoo Tech present the remark as a stark warning about the rapid ascent of machine intelligence, tying the quote to broader discussions about AI risk.

Neither outlet's coverage details any policy proposals or subsequent actions tied to the remark; the focus is on the notoriety and provocative nature of the quote itself, rather than a concrete roadmap for governance or safety measures.
